issues.sym: The transmission slips, flares in revs between gears, jerks hard when you shift from Reverse to Drive, or suddenly locks up and stops pulling. Owners report failures from very low mileage up to well past 100,000 miles.
issues.why: Transmission failure is the most-reported problem on the Borrego. Some trucks had their transmission replaced or rebuilt and still slipped afterwards, which points to internal wear and control problems rather than one simple part.
issues.next: Check the fluid level and condition first. If it slips or will not move, stop driving it hard and get a transmission diagnosis. Ask a Kia dealer whether any software update or bulletin repair has not yet been done on your VIN.

issues.t: Stuck in third gear with a warning light on
issues.sym: A warning light comes on and the transmission holds third gear, will not upshift or downshift normally, or the shifter sticks in Park. Some owners say it shifts abruptly from third to fourth.
issues.why: Kia issued technical service bulletin 035 (revised in 2011) for 2009 Borregos with this exact pattern and stored internal transmission trouble codes. In this state the transmission computer is protecting itself in a fixed gear.
issues.next: Have the transmission codes read and ask a Kia dealer to check TSB 035 REV 1 against your VIN. Avoid highway merging and towing while it is stuck in one gear.

issues.t: Delayed or rough shifts on early V6 models
issues.sym: A slow, delayed shift when pulling out of Park, hesitation going into gear, slow downshifts on hills, or clunky shifts.
issues.why: Borregos with the 3.8L V6 built through January 15, 2009 had transmission computer programming that caused shift delay and poor shift quality. Kia released a transmission computer software update for them under a service campaign (SA 016, bulletin TSB-027).
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer to confirm the TCM software update has been done. It is a quick reflash, and it should be checked before any bigger transmission work.

issues.t: Brake pedal mount can break in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No warning beforehand. After a collision, the brake pedal may not work, leaving only the parking brake to stop the vehicle.
issues.why: On Borregos built from May 2008 to January 2009 with non-adjustable pedals, the brake pedal mount was made of a fiberglass composite that can break off in some crashes. Kia recalled about 21,900 trucks (NHTSA 12V245, Kia SC096).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Kia dealers replace the brake pedal mount free of charge.

issues.sym: Brake lights that stay off when you brake (or flicker), cruise control that will not switch off, warning lights, and a shifter that will not leave Park, or that can be moved out of Park without pressing the brake.
issues.why: The brake (stop lamp) switch could work only on and off. Kia recalled this switch on the Borrego and other models in 2013 (NHTSA 13V114). The same switch tells the cruise control and the shift lock when you are braking.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the switch replaced free at a Kia dealer. Until then, ask someone to watch your brake lights when you press the pedal.

issues.t: Headliner plates can come loose when airbags deploy (recall)
issues.sym: Nothing you would notice day to day. In a crash that fires the side curtain airbags, plastic plates in the headliner can come loose and fly into the cabin.
issues.why: Too little adhesive was used at the factory to hold the left and right headliner plates in place. Kia recalled about 22,700 2009 Borregos in 2023 (NHTSA 23V692).
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. A Kia dealer will add industrial-grade adhesive tape over the plates for free, and owners who already paid for the fix can ask for a refund.

issues.t: Shifter won't move into or out of Park
issues.sym: The shift lever will not leave Park, will not go back into Park, or will not go into Reverse. The key may not come out because the truck is not in Park.
issues.why: The shift lock depends on the brake light switch and the transmission controls. Owners report these lockouts alongside warning lights, and Kia's brake light switch recall and TSB 035 both describe a shifter stuck in Park.
issues.next: Use the shift lock release slot near the shifter to move it in an emergency. Then have the brake light switch recall and transmission codes checked by a dealer.

issues.t: Check engine light with throttle code P2135
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on, often with trouble code P2135, and the engine may go into a reduced-power mode.
issues.why: Code P2135 means the two throttle position signals do not agree. Kia found that engine computer programming could set this code on Borregos and released an engine computer software update (TSB-043).
issues.next: Have the code read. If it is P2135, ask a Kia dealer about the TSB-043 software update before replacing the throttle body.

issues.t: Check engine light from engine computer software (V6)
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with codes such as P0110, P0111, P0116 or P1618B, often with no change in how the engine runs.
issues.why: Kia found that the engine computer software on some 2009 Borregos with the 3.8L V6 could set these codes and issued a software upgrade in bulletin TSB-074.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask a Kia dealer whether the TSB-074 software update has been done before replacing sensors.

issues.t: Rough idle or misfire from a sticking oil control valve
issues.sym: Rough idle, sluggish acceleration, a check engine light with camshaft timing or misfire codes.
issues.why: The engine uses oil-pressure-controlled valves (oil control valves) to shift the camshaft timing. Kia's TSB-046 tells technicians to suspect a sticking oil control valve for these symptoms. Old or low oil makes them stick more.
issues.next: Check the oil level and have the oil changed if it is due. Have the codes read; replacing an oil control valve is a modest repair compared with chasing other parts.

issues.sym: A low booming or droning sound inside the cabin when the engine is around 2,000 rpm.
issues.why: Kia traced this noise on 2009 Borregos to the thermostat housing and released a revised housing to stop it.
issues.next: It is not harmful, but if it bothers you, ask a Kia dealer about the revised thermostat housing.

issues.t: Power tailgate works on and off or not at all
issues.sym: The power rear tailgate (liftgate) opens or closes only sometimes, or stops working.
issues.why: The tailgate actuator has a gear that wears or slips. Kia redesigned the actuator gear and its outer cover and issued bulletin TSB-041 for it.
issues.next: Have the actuator checked. Ask for the redesigned part so it does not fail again.

issues.t: Seat belt won't latch or comes unlatched
issues.sym: A seat belt does not click in, or it releases from the buckle on its own while driving, sometimes several times.
issues.why: Owners report seat belt buckles that do not latch properly. A worn or dirty buckle mechanism is the usual cause.
issues.next: Do not ignore it: an unlatched belt gives no protection. Have the buckle inspected and replaced, and check that the belt holds when you pull on it firmly.

issues.t: Steering heavy or hard to turn at speed
issues.sym: The steering feels unusually heavy or almost locks for a moment, often at higher speeds or after a bump, then returns to normal.
issues.why: Owners have reported this to NHTSA, but dealers often found no fault. Suspected causes include the power steering pump and worn steering parts such as tie rod ends.
issues.next: Check the power steering fluid level and look for leaks. If the steering ever binds, have the pump, hoses and steering linkage inspected before driving at speed.

issues.t: Steering column won't tilt or telescope
issues.sym: The steering wheel will not move up, down, in or out, or it stays stuck in one position. One owner noticed it starting in hot weather.
issues.why: Owners report the adjustable steering column jamming. The exact cause was not identified in the reports.
issues.next: Have a shop inspect the column lock mechanism. Make sure the wheel is locked firmly in place before driving.

issues.t: ESC and downhill brake lights come on
issues.sym: The stability control (ESC/ESP) and downhill brake control lights come on and off, sometimes with brake warning lights while driving.
issues.why: Owners have filed several stability control complaints with NHTSA. These systems rely on the brake light switch and wheel speed and ABS signals, so a faulty brake light switch (see the recall) is one known trigger. A shop will also check the sensors and the ABS unit.
issues.next: Have the ABS and stability control codes read, and check whether the brake light switch recall has been done on your VIN.

issues.t: Emissions monitors won't finish after a battery change
issues.sym: The truck fails a plug-in emissions test because the EGR readiness monitor shows "not ready", often after a new battery or a computer reset.
issues.why: Kia issued a service notice that some Borregos cannot complete the EGR readiness check after a battery replacement or engine computer memory reset.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer about service notice PS418 before the inspection. A shop can run the right drive cycle to set the monitors.

issues.t: Driver seat suddenly drops or comes loose
issues.sym: The power driver seat drops to its lowest position, jerks, or comes loose, and the seat buttons stop working.
issues.why: Owners report the seat height adjuster arm unhooking or a seat mounting stud breaking.
issues.next: Do not drive with a loose seat. Have the seat track and adjuster inspected and repaired right away.
